# Endtest

> Endtest is an agentic AI test automation platform for end-to-end testing of web and mobile applications. The agent drives real browsers on real Windows and macOS machines, plans tests from natural-language descriptions, executes them, observes the results, and adapts — across creation, execution, self-healing maintenance, and failure analysis.

Endtest Inc. is headquartered in Delaware, USA. The platform has been in production since 2016 and is ISO 27001 certified, GDPR compliant, and HIPAA compliant. Customers include Dow Jones, Malwarebytes, and The Washington Post.

The product is positioned as a complete test automation platform — codeless test authoring, agentic AI for the full test lifecycle, and a real-machine browser/device cloud — distinct from device-only services (like BrowserStack and Sauce Labs) that require teams to write and maintain their own Selenium or Appium frameworks.

## Product

- [Endtest homepage](https://endtest.io/): overview of the platform and the agentic AI loop
- [Pricing](https://endtest.io/pricing): plan details
- [AI Test Creation Agent](https://endtest.io/product/create/ai-test-creation-agent): generate automated tests from natural-language scenarios
- [Codeless Recorder](https://endtest.io/product/create/codeless-recorder): record web tests in the browser
- [Mobile Test Recorder](https://endtest.io/product/create/mobile-test-recorder): record native iOS and Android tests
- [AI Test Import](https://endtest.io/product/create/ai-test-import): import existing tests from other tools
- [Web Testing](https://endtest.io/product/test-types/web-testing): browser testing on real Windows and macOS machines
- [Mobile App Testing](https://endtest.io/product/test-types/mobile-app-testing): native iOS and Android testing
- [API Testing](https://endtest.io/product/test-types/api-testing): API requests as part of end-to-end flows
- [Email and SMS Testing](https://endtest.io/product/test-types/email-sms-testing): verify magic links, 2FA codes, and notifications
- [PDF Testing](https://endtest.io/product/test-types/pdf-testing): validate PDF outputs
- [Visual AI](https://endtest.io/product/validate/visual-ai): AI-driven visual regression detection
- [Cross-Browser Testing](https://endtest.io/product/validate/cross-browser-testing): real Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge
- [Accessibility Testing](https://endtest.io/product/validate/accessibility-testing): automated a11y checks
- [Self-Healing Tests](https://endtest.io/product/execute/self-healing-tests): locators that adapt to UI changes
- [Test Orchestration](https://endtest.io/product/execute/test-orchestration): parallel runs, scheduling, CI/CD integrations
- [Test Insights](https://endtest.io/product/analyze/test-insights): AI-powered failure analysis and triage
- [Automated Maintenance](https://endtest.io/product/analyze/automated-maintenance): keep suites green as the app evolves
- [No-Code Testing](https://endtest.io/product/capabilities/no-code-testing): build tests without writing code
- [Data-Driven Testing](https://endtest.io/product/capabilities/data-driven-testing): run the same test with varied data sets
- [Geolocation Testing](https://endtest.io/product/capabilities/geolocation-testing): test from real locations worldwide
- [AI Assertions](https://endtest.io/product/capabilities/ai-assertions): assert outcomes in natural language
- [AI Variables](https://endtest.io/product/capabilities/ai-variables): extract values from a page using natural-language prompts
